full_judgment: 2. The present leave-petitioners, as plaintiffs, instituted Title Suit No. 16 of 1998 in the court of the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Dhamrai, Dhaka paying for setting aside the ex-parte judgment and decree passed in Title suit No. 149 of 1995 and also praying for cancellation of registered deed dated 25.11.1997 as well as for recovery of khas possession. The defendant No. 1 appeared in that suit and contested by filing written statement. The trial court, after hearing the parties and considering the evidence adduced by them decreed the suit.
